_comment: WC2026 ROUND OF 16 (bracket tie 92: winner of USA-Bosnia vs winner of Belgium-Senegal). KNOCKOUT: no draw -- level after 90' -> extra time -> penalties, so the deliverable is who ADVANCES. Winner meets Spain (who beat Portugal 1-0) in the quarter-finals. Routes: USA is a co-HOST -- won Group D (4-1 Paraguay, 2-0 Australia, 2-3 Turkey; 6 pts, GF 8 GA 4, rating 79), ATTACKING (8 goals) but leaky at the back (lost 2-3 to Turkey) -- then beat Bosnia 2-0 in the R32 (a clean sheet at home). USA plays with a REAL home advantage (US crowd). Belgium WON Group G (1-1 Egypt, 0-0 Iran, 5-1 New Zealand; 5 pts, GF 6 GA 2, rating 86) -- quality but BLUNT vs organized sides (frustrated to 1-1/0-0 by Egypt/Iran), explosive vs open ones (5-1 NZ) -- then beat Senegal 3-2 in EXTRA TIME (came from 2-0 down) in the R32. Class gap ~7 (86 vs 79) -> Belgium the favourite by class, BUT USA's real HOME advantage narrows it sharply toward a near coin-flip (Belgium the slight favourite). KEY texture: both are ATTACKING and both are somewhat LEAKY (USA GA 4, Belgium conceded to Senegal/Egypt) -> an OPEN, higher-scoring, BTTS-live game (favourite+goals), NOT a low-block grind. BTTS DECISION: Belgium the clear-ish favourite (rule -> lean No), BUT USA is a HOME side with a genuine attack (8 group goals) -- NOT an away leaky-minnow that gets shut out (the USA/Switzerland/Canada shut-out profile). So BTTS is kept NEAR-NEUTRAL / slight-Yes (~57%), NOT forced to No: USA can score at home and Belgium's defence is leaky-ish; but flagged two-way -- Belgium COULD shut out a non-elite USA attack (that is the rule's caution). RECAL: first pass (USA 1.32 / BEL 1.50) sat 3.7 pts ABOVE the market on USA (32.6 vs 28.9) -- over-crediting the co-host edge (the Canada-Morocco error); trimmed USA 1.32 -> 1.25 and lifted BEL 1.50 -> 1.55 to align. Home = USA (REAL home). Cards not modelled (referee TBD).
